name: Sarnafast KTL
paste:
SARNAFAST® KTL: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sarnafast® KTL, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sarnafast_ktl.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sarnafast® KTL where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Zinc plated steel washes with diamond-shaped reinforcement and specially stamped barbs for the mechanical fastening of roof waterproofing membranes. Hole diameter 7.5 mm.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Mechanically fastened roof waterproofing membranes by spot fastening in overlaps and / or intermediate spot fastening in combination with fastener Sarnafast® SBF-6.0 or SBF-S-6.0.
    - Only for fastening roof waterproofing membranes over compressible thermal insulation (not for use on hard substrates).
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sarnafast® KTL
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Metal washer for spot fastening in overlaps and intermediate fastening in mechanically fastened roofing systems
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Quality Management System EN ISO 9001/14001
    - European Technical Approval ETA-08/0262
    - Factory Mutual Class No. 4470
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN ISO 9001/14001: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ETA-08/0262: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - DIN 50018: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Corrosion resistance (p.2).
    - ETAG 006: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Corrosion resistance (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Lightweight
    - Resistance to common environmental influences
    - Easy to use and install with recommended tools
    - Recyclable
2.5 Appearance and colour.
    | Surface | smooth |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Dimensions: 82 × 40 mm, hole diameter 7.5 mm, thickness 1 mm
    - Corrosion resistance: 15 cycles Kesternich test (concentration SFW 2.0 S in accordance with DIN 50018) according to ETAG 006 – D.3.1.
2.7 System structure. Ancillary products:
    - Sarnafast® Fastener SBF-6.0
    - Sarnafast® Fastener SBF-S-6.0
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Loose, packaging unit 250 pieces / box; Article No.: 111097
    - Shelf life: Sarnafast® KTL does not expire during correct storage.
    - Storage conditions: Sarnafast® KTL shall be stored in dry conditions.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - Sarnafast® KTL must be installed in accordance with the Sika application manual and installation instructions.
    - Sarnafast® KTL in combination with Sarnafast® Fastener SBF-6.0 or SBF-S-6.0 is used for the mechanical fastening of roof waterproofing membranes.
    - For more information please refer to the Product Data Sheets for Sarnafast® Fastener SBF-6.0 or SBF-S-6.0.
4.3 Application.
    - Installation works to be carried out only by experienced Sika trained roofing contractors.
    - Additional measures may be required for installation at below +5 °C ambient temperature in accordance with all relevant local regulations.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations - Geographical / Climate. The use of Sarnafast® KTL is limited to geographical locations with average monthly minimum temperatures of -50 °C. Permanent ambient temperature during use is limited to +50 °C.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. -20 °C min. / +60 °C max.
5.3 Substrate temperature. -30 °C min. / +60 °C max.
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.4):
    - The use of Sarnafast® KTL is limited to geographical locations with average monthly minimum temperatures of -50 °C. Permanent ambient temperature during use is limited to +50 °C.
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sarnafast® KTL, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sarnafast_ktl.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
